d:
Shimron Hetmyer brought the fireworks to Abu Dhabi with a blistering 76 off just 28 balls! His explosive knock powered Emirates Eagles to a massive 137/7 in 10 overs.
UAE Bulls fought back with the bat, but Haider Razzaq's sensational four-wicket haul ensured Emirates Eagles sealed a convincing 25-run victory in the 10th match of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026.
Keep watching 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
